findings.documented: Append the API key as a query parameter (?api_key=...)
findings.actual: The API requires the key to be sent in the X-API-Key request header, not as a query param.
findings.how_found: Wrote a test script following the docs and the server returned an error instructing to use the header.
findings.impact: Crucial. Following the documentation makes it impossible to authenticate any request.

findings.documented: Returns `token`, expires in 86400s (24h), and claims there is no refresh flow.
findings.actual: Returns `access_token`, expires in 900s (15m), and includes a `refresh_token` with a `/auth/refresh` URL.
findings.how_found: Inspected the actual response body of a successful POST /auth/login request.
findings.impact: High. The app will crash trying to read the wrong token key, and sessions will expire in 15 minutes instead of 24 hours.

findings.documented: Claims inactive listings are excluded server-side and safe to show users. The `is_live` field is undocumented.
findings.actual: The endpoint returns hundreds of inactive listings, distinguishable only by the undocumented `is_live: false` boolean.
findings.how_found: Downloaded the entire dataset and filtered for `is_live === false`.
findings.impact: Critical. Frontends relying on the documentation will display withdrawn or sold properties to users.

findings.documented: Claims each listing record corresponds to exactly one physical property.
findings.actual: 3,300 retrievable listing records describe only 50 unique physical properties, showing extensive duplication.
findings.how_found: Generated composite property keys using GPS coordinates, floor, bedrooms, and carpet area, then grouped listings by key.
findings.impact: High. Inventory counts and analytics will overestimate physical supply by over 60x without deduplication.

findings.documented: Returns metadata per project including a `total_listings` count representing active listings.
findings.actual: 356 out of 400 projects report inaccurate `total_listings` counts when cross-referenced against retrievable records.
findings.how_found: Paginating through `/v1/projects`, extracting `total_listings`, and comparing against grouped counts from `/v1/listings`.
findings.impact: High. Frontends displaying project summary counts will show inaccurate availability data to users.
